This slice owns only mute-state load/type/initial/toggles/auth-boundary observer/imports/comments; E2EE declarations/assignments/reset changes require their own review and evidence. No broad formatter or E2EE edits were performed here.
contract: Voice isMuted remains effective microphone mute. Entering local deafen captures manual mute intent and forces effective mute. Explicit undeafen restores that intent, so a previously manually muted microphone stays muted.

Mute toggles while locally deafened change queued manual intent only; they neither undeafen nor enable capture. UserBar tooltip/accessible action labels describe the queued action while its effective muted icon remains. Private P2P controls describe their separate queued manual intent similarly.

Mute/deafen intent is device-local, never synchronized to the server. Legacy deafened state without trustworthy prior intent remains muted on undeafen. A queued unmute is discarded on account/auth-generation changes; same-account call/channel teardown and account-preference resets retain the privacy state.

Main LiveKit publication defensively checks local deafen alongside existing local/server mute gates, including explicit stale enable requests. Existing capture cancellation and publication guards remain.

P2P manual mute remains separate. Only global LOCAL deafen gates private capture; another guild moderator server-mute does not gain control over a private P2P microphone. Current and staged processed outputs are silenced immediately, and preparation/replacement continuations recheck effective mute before attachment. Undeafen restores the private call manual choice rather than overwriting it.
No microphone processing engine, group-call audio path, overlay controls, server permission policy, output graph or E2EE protocol was changed by this slice.
